'''Beolars Bribbs''' was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as [[President of the Sullustan Council]] and [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] of [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] in the lead-up to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Bribbs was elected shortly after [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] and its ''de facto'' corporation-run-government body, SoroSuub, aligned itself with the growing [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] movement through its connections to the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]]. In his inaugural speech, standing beside Guild Presidente [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], Bribbs outlined his platform of guiding Sullust through the rocky pre-[[Clone Wars/Legends|war]] days on his framing of Sullustan value: "Hard work, persistence, and the cherishing of family is the Sullustan brand identity." He supported the controversial doubling of SoroSuub shareholder votes in future Sullustan elections, which presumably led to SoroSuub taking over the Sullustan Council.<ref name="HHN 46">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_1.html|Sullustans Elect President}}</ref>

At some point during the Imperial period, Beolars Bribbs, in addition to his becoming [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|CEO]] of SoroSuub, also worked with the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]], where he had aided in the development of the [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]] and the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]], respectively, acting as the Chief Architect of both designs.

==Behind the scenes==
His name is also spelled "Beolar Bribbs".
